pick.headline: Earthquake devastates Mexico City
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of September 20, 1985, listed under Mexico the earthquake with an estimated 3,000 dead, reports of US diplomats killed, the president's comments, damage in Acapulco, and continuing tremors.
